title: KAITO — Happy Anniversary!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough for our final practice! I think our song and dance are good to go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yay...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great work up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, which just leaves rehearsing in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's keep doing everything we can to make sure KAITO's anniversary show goes well.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now, why don't we get changed to stay warm and head over to SEKAI a little early?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wait!
There's something I want to do here before we do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, not actually do, but watch...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You want to watch something?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. The anniversary stream for KAITO's going to start in just a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you mean this KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Ichika told me about how they're going to be streaming his anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I was hoping to watch it before we headed over to SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I don't think I've ever seen any of this KAITO's shows or streams before.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to see what it's like as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We still have time, so why not?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. We can watch it after we get changed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I heard that they'll respond to some of our comments, so I'm curious to see how exactly...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, this could also be a learning experience for us in terms of doing streams.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you know when it's supposed to start, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Gimme just one second. Um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! I-It starts in ten minutes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-Why didn't you tell us that first...?!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Welcome to KAITO's anniversary show, everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We made it. Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, we could've just started watching it while we were changing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is his anniversary stream!
We all need to wear cute or at least nice clothes while sitting crisscross applesauce!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Criss-cross applesauce...?
That might be going a little too far...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And thank you to everyone celebrating KAITO's anniversary by watching the stream. Can you all hear us okay?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Aren't you going to write a comment, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you're right! I got so caught up in the show that I forgot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
How about...?
<I'm celebrating with my friends!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, maybe I should add that we're on our school's rooftop?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Look, here comes KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thank you for coming to my anniversary show today, everyone.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And hello to everyone watching the stream. I hope you enjoy everything as well.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <KAITO! Over here!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We wanna do a big lap of the stage together, so let's head over to where Miku and the others are!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, so hurry!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. I'll be right there.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, looks like Rin and Len are his escorts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They seem so excited about celebrating his anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Look, they're waving at us! They're so cute together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At this point, KAITO sort of seems like a distant cousin or relative.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get what you mean. Also, he's the star of today's show, so he has every right to take the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's like he wants everyone else to have a chance to stand front and center, you know?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That may be because he cares about Miku and the others so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, the show's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! A duet with MEIKO to start things off!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This song's so romantic too. It suits them so well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really does. It also compliments the celebratory theme of the show very well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, working these extra dimensions into a show isn't exactly easy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know it was just their first song, but this show's already super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd say it's a testament to just how amazing their song was just now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. The chorus gave me goosebumps because it was so good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. KAITO seems so happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, he does.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll need to really do our best to make sure our show in SEKAI today goes as well as possible so that our KAITO gets to feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Of course!
